title: 第二十八章 伐天联盟，兵临城下
content_zh:
万剑轮回境中，时光飞逝。

    林墨盘坐于一片由无数破碎剑意凝聚而成的虚空之中，周身环绕着浓郁的、几乎化为实质的剑罡。他的气息，比进入之前，变得更加深沉、内敛，仿佛一柄经过千锤百炼、即将出鞘的神锋。

    他体内，“无始皇道剑胎”已经彻底稳固，并且开始衍生出更加玄奥的变化。剑胎之上，隐约浮现出一些古老的符文，那是剑皇传承和《无始剑经》更深层次的奥秘，正在被他逐步领悟和吸收。他的修为，也从初入道宫境，一路突破，达到了道宫境中期，距离后期也只差临门一脚。

    然而，就在他准备一鼓作气，冲击更高境界时，万剑轮回境的空间，忽然微微波动起来。一道急促的传讯符，穿透了空间的阻隔，落入他的手中。

    传讯符中，只带来了一个消息，却如同晴天霹雳，让林墨的心瞬间沉到了谷底：

    “伐天联盟，兵临城下！宗门危急！速归！”

    “伐天联盟？”林墨眉头紧锁。他虽然闭关，但对外界局势并非一无所知。他知道战族和轩辕帝族不会善罢甘休，却没想到，他们竟然如此之快地组建了联盟，并且直接打到了天剑宗家门口！

    他再也无心修炼，长身而起，一步踏出万剑轮回境。

    当他走出闭关之地，来到天剑宗山门时，眼前的景象，让他倒吸一口冷气。

    只见天剑宗山门之外，原本晴朗的天空，此刻已经被密密麻麻、遮天蔽日的各种飞行法宝、战车、妖兽所覆盖！无数旌旗在风中猎猎作响，上面绣着“战”、“轩辕”、“伐天”等字样，散发出冲天的杀气！

    联军之中，强者如云！光是神台境的气息，就有不下十道！甚至，在联军后方，还隐隐有几道更加恐怖、仿佛与天地融为一体的气息，那是属于圣墟境大能的威压！

    天剑宗的护山大阵，已经全面开启，形成一道巨大的、如同碗状倒扣的青色光罩，将整个宗门笼罩在内。光罩之上，无数剑影流转，散发出凌厉的剑意，抵御着联军的攻击。但此刻，光罩已经在联军的狂轰滥炸下，剧烈地颤抖、波动，仿佛随时都可能破碎！

    山门内，天剑宗所有弟子、长老，都已经严阵以待。他们脸上带着紧张、愤怒，但更多的，是一种决绝！宗门有难，匹夫有责！没有人退缩！

    宗主和几位太上长老，站在山门最高处，神色凝重地看着山下那如同潮水般的联军。无名太上也在其中，他虽然压制了“锈”毒，但脸色依旧有些苍白，气息也远未恢复到巅峰状态。

    “战族！轩辕帝族！你们当真要与我天剑宗，不死不休吗？！”宗主的声音，如同雷霆般，滚滚传出，带着无尽的怒火和悲愤。

    “不死不休？呵呵……你们天剑宗，包庇妖孽林墨，纵容他残害我轩辕帝族天骄，更是与那灭世之‘锈’，有着不清不楚的瓜葛！今日，我伐天联盟，便是要为天下苍生，铲除你们这帮祸害！”联军之中，一名身穿轩辕帝族服饰、气息恐怖的老者，冷声喝道。他正是当日出现在问道台的轩辕帝族强者之一。

    “欲加之罪，何患无辞！”一名天剑宗太上长老气得浑身发抖，“你们分明是觊觎我天剑宗的传承和林墨所得的剑皇宝藏！何必说得如此冠冕堂皇！”

    “废话少说！交出林墨，交出剑皇传承和始令！否则，今日便踏平你天剑宗！”战族的一名神台境巅峰强者，不耐烦地吼道。他手中战斧一挥，一道恐怖的斧芒，再次狠狠劈在护山大阵上，让光罩剧烈摇晃，裂开一道道蛛网般的裂纹！

    天剑宗众人，脸色都是一白。护山大阵，恐怕支撑不了多久了！

    就在这时——

    “想动我天剑宗，先问过我手中之剑！”

    一道冰冷、坚定、带着无边怒意的声音，如同惊雷般，从天剑宗深处炸响！

    紧接着，一道璀璨到极致的剑光，冲天而起！剑光之中，一道白衣身影，如同神剑降世，携带着斩灭一切的意志，直扑山下那联军最密集之处！
content_en:
In the realm of reincarnation of ten thousand swords, time flies by.

    Lin Mo sat cross-legged in a void condensed by countless broken sword intentions, surrounded by a thick sword gang that had almost turned into substance. His breath became deeper and more restrained than before entering, like a sharp sword that had been tempered many times and was about to be unsheathed.

    In his body, the "Sword Embryo of the Emperor's Dao" has been completely stabilized, and has begun to undergo more mysterious changes. On the sword embryo, some ancient runes vaguely emerged, which were the deeper mysteries of the Sword King's inheritance and the "Wu Shi Sword Sutra", which he was gradually comprehending and absorbing. His cultivation level has also broken through all the way since he first entered the Dao Palace Realm, reaching the middle stage of the Dao Palace Realm, and he is only one step away from the later stage.

    However, just when he was about to go all out and hit a higher realm, the space in the Ten Thousand Swords Reincarnation Realm suddenly fluctuated slightly. A rapid communication talisman penetrated the barrier of space and fell into his hand.

    The communication talisman only brought one piece of news, but it was like a bolt from the blue, causing Lin Mo's heart to sink to the bottom instantly:

    "Fatian Alliance, troops are approaching the city! The sect is in danger! Return quickly!"

    "Fighting Alliance?" Lin Mo frowned. Although he is in seclusion, he is not completely ignorant of the external situation. He knew that the Zhan Clan and the Xuanyuan Emperor Clan would not give up, but he did not expect that they would form an alliance so quickly and attack directly at the door of the Tianjian Sect!

    He no longer had the intention to practice, so he stood up and stepped out of the Ten Thousand Swords Reincarnation Realm in one step.

    When he walked out of the retreat and came to the gate of Tianjian Sect, the sight in front of him made him take a breath of air.

    Outside the Tianjian Sect's mountain gate, the originally clear sky was now covered by densely packed flying magic weapons, chariots, and monster beasts that blocked the sky! Countless flags rustled in the wind, embroidered with the words "War", "Xuanyuan", "Fighting the Sky" and other words on them, exuding a murderous aura that soared into the sky!

    Among the coalition forces, there are many strong men! There are no less than ten auras from the Shentai realm alone! Even behind the coalition forces, there are still a few more terrifying auras that seem to be integrated with the heaven and earth. That is the pressure of a powerful person in the Holy Ruins Realm!

    The Tianjian Sect's mountain-protecting formation has been fully activated, forming a huge, bowl-shaped inverted blue light shield, covering the entire sect. Above the light shield, countless sword shadows circulated, exuding fierce sword intent, resisting the attack of the coalition forces. But at this moment, the mask was already trembling and fluctuating violently under the indiscriminate bombardment of the coalition forces, as if it might break at any time!

    Inside the mountain gate, all the disciples and elders of the Tianjian Sect were ready. There was tension and anger on their faces, but more importantly, a kind of determination! When the sect is in trouble, everyone is responsible! No one holds back!

    The sect master and several supreme elders stood at the highest point of the mountain gate, looking solemnly at the tide of coalition forces down the mountain. The Nameless Supreme Being was also among them. Although he suppressed the "rust" poison, his face was still a little pale and his aura was far from returning to its peak state.

    "War Clan! Xuanyuan Imperial Clan! Do you really want to fight with me, Tianjian Sect, to the death?!" The sect leader's voice rolled out like thunder, filled with endless anger and grief.

    "Until death? Haha... You, Tianjian Sect, sheltered the evildoer Lin Mo and allowed him to harm our Xuanyuan Emperor Clan's genius. You also have an unclear relationship with the world-destroying 'Rust'! Today, I, the Defeating Heaven Alliance, are going to eradicate your scourge for the common people in the world!" Among the coalition forces, an old man wearing the Xuanyuan Emperor Clan's clothing and with a terrifying aura shouted coldly. He was one of the powerful men from the Xuanyuan Imperial Clan who appeared on the platform that day.

    "If you want to accuse me, why bother?" A Supreme Elder of the Heavenly Sword Sect was trembling with anger. "You clearly covet the inheritance of my Heavenly Sword Sect and the Sword King's treasure obtained by Lin Mo! Why do you have to say it so grandly!"

    "Stop talking nonsense! Hand over Lin Mo, hand over the Sword King's inheritance and the First Order! Otherwise, your Tianjian Sect will be crushed today!" A peak Shentai realm expert from the War Clan shouted impatiently. He swung the battle ax in his hand, and a terrifying ax light struck the mountain-protecting formation again, causing the light shield to shake violently and split into spiderweb-like cracks!

    Everyone in Tianjian Sect turned pale. I'm afraid the mountain-protecting formation won't last long!

    Just then——

    "If you want to touch my Heavenly Sword Sect, ask me about the sword in my hand first!"

    A cold, firm, and boundless angry voice exploded from the depths of Tianjian Sect like thunder!

    Immediately afterwards, a brilliant sword light rose into the sky! In the sword light, a figure in white, like a divine sword coming to the world, carrying the will to destroy everything, went straight to the densest place of the coalition forces at the foot of the mountain!
title_en: Chapter 28: The Fighting Alliance arrives at the city gates
